comment.narrative: UNFPA HQ conducted two training sessions specifically on ME and other 2 learning activities ondata and measurement on son preference and GBSS. The first ME training was delivered as part of the validationof the online training module on GBSS in May 2022. The second ME session was held in June 2022.
